data.name: Schema
data.value: CREATE TABLE user_source_accounts ( user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, source_person_id uuid NOT NULL, company_id uuid NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_user_source_pair UNIQUE (source_person_id, company_id)); CREATE TABLE user_source_account_revisions ( user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES user_source_accounts(user_id), revision_id varchar(200) NOT NULL, known_at_ticks bigint NOT NULL, snapshot_json text NOT NULL, request_hash varchar(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, revision_id), UNIQUE (user_id, known_at_ticks));

data.name: Drop
data.value: DROP TABLE user_source_account_revisions; DROP TABLE user_source_accounts;

data.name: Lock
data.value: LOCK TABLE user_source_accounts IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE

data.name: Identity
data.value: SELECT user_id, source_person_id, company_id FROM user_source_accounts WHERE user_id = @userId

data.name: Pair
data.value: SELECT user_id, source_person_id, company_id FROM user_source_accounts WHERE source_person_id = @sourcePersonId AND company_id = @companyId

data.name: CanBind
data.value: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_source_accounts WHERE (user_id = @userId AND (source_person_id != @sourcePersonId OR company_id != @companyId)) OR (source_person_id = @sourcePersonId AND company_id = @companyId AND user_id != @userId))

data.name: ViewerCompatible
data.value: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_source_accounts WHERE user_id = @userId AND (company_id != @companyId OR CAST(@sourcePersonId AS uuid) IS NULL OR source_person_id != CAST(@sourcePersonId AS uuid)))

data.name: LockAuthLineage
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT source_person_id::text FROM users WHERE id = @userId FOR UPDATE), '') AS source_person_id

data.name: InsertIdentity
data.value: INSERT INTO user_source_accounts (user_id, source_person_id, company_id) VALUES (@userId, @sourcePersonId, @companyId) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

data.name: Revision
data.value: SELECT snapshot_json, request_hash FROM user_source_account_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId AND revision_id = @revisionId

data.name: Latest
data.value: SELECT snapshot_json, request_hash FROM user_source_account_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId AND known_at_ticks <= @asOfTicks ORDER BY known_at_ticks DESC LIMIT 1

data.name: LatestByPair
data.value: SELECT r.snapshot_json, r.request_hash FROM user_source_account_revisions r JOIN user_source_accounts a ON a.user_id = r.user_id WHERE a.source_person_id = @sourcePersonId AND a.company_id = @companyId AND r.known_at_ticks <= @asOfTicks ORDER BY r.known_at_ticks DESC LIMIT 1

data.name: LastTime
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(known_at_ticks), 0) FROM user_source_account_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId

data.name: InsertRevision
data.value: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO user_source_account_revisions (user_id, revision_id, known_at_ticks, snapshot_json, request_hash) VALUES (@userId, @revisionId, @knownAtTicks, @snapshotJson, @requestHash) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING revision_id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT revision_id FROM inserted), '') AS revision_id
